contexts.text: (Angelic Spirits forming a lamp-stand with its lamps and flowers in honour of the Lord.) SE 2646.
The candlestick with its seven lamps = the Lord; the lamps = the holy things of love... AC 886:2.
Candlesticks () = the truths of these goods.
Golden candlesticks = truths of good.

In order to represent Divine truth proceeding from the Lord's Divine good, they were commanded to make a candlestick of pure gold with seven lamps, and to set it in the tent of the assembly at the table containing the show-bread... Illustrated. AC 10206:end.
The candlestick () = the Lord as to Divine truth.
The candlestick = the celestial things, and Aaron's garments the spiritual things which are from the Lord in the Heavens.

Thou shalt make a candlestick () = the Spiritual Heaven. A candlestick = the Divine Spiritual in Heaven and in the Church from the Lord. The reason the candlestick = the Divine Spiritual, is that the table = the Divine celestial... The reason the candlestick = the Divine Spiritual, is from the illumination, for the Divine truth which proceeds from the Lord's Divine good is what shines in Heaven. AC 9561. AC 9562.
That the candlestick = the Spiritual Heaven from the Divine truth which is from the Lord, thus also the Church, Illustrated.

Why the candlestick was of pure gold. The candlestick = the Divine Spiritual, or the Divine truth which is from the Lord in Heaven and the Church; and because this comes forth from Divine good, the candlestick was of gold.
The candlestick shall be solid = that the whole is from good.
The candlestick = the Divine Spiritual which is from the Divine Celestial.
The candlestick = the Divine Spiritual which is in Heaven and in the Church from the Lord.

The candlestick opposite the table upon the side of the habitation towards the south () = the illumination of the Spiritual Kingdom by means of the Divine truth proceeding from the Lord's Divine Human to those who are in good. The candlestick = the Lord as to Divine truth, thus the Divine truth proceeding from His Divine Human, and thence illumination for His Spiritual Kingdom...

The candlestick in the Habitation represented the Moon from which there is light for those who are of the Spiritual Kingdom; thus it represented the Lord as to Divine truth there... Hence it is evident Why the candlestick was placed towards the south...
That a candlestick = Divine truth proceeding from the Lord's Divine Human, Illustrated.
The two olive-trees, and the two candlesticks () = these same goods (that is, the good of love to the Lord and the good of charity towards the neighbour).
The luminary, or candlestick = the Spiritual Heaven.
By the lamps of the candlestick were represented charity and faith.

The candlestick and its vessels () = in the spiritual truth which is of the second Heaven, and in ministering truths. The candlestick = a representative of the Lord as to spiritual truth, which is of the second Heaven.

The pure candlestick and all its vessels () = a representative of truth from that good, and the ministering things. The candlestick with its lamps and branches = a representative of the Spiritual Heaven, and of faith and intelligence from the Lord there; thus of truth from good.
To them the Word is like a candlestick without a light...
Like a candelabrum with its lamps lighted. TCR 227.
Being turned, I saw seven golden candlesticks () = the New Church which will be in enlightenment from the Lord out of the Word. Explained.
The candlesticks were not one near another, placed in contact with each other, but at a distance from one another in a kind of circle...
The golden candlestick in the tabernacle represented the Church as to enlightenment from the Lord.
As the Church is the Church from the Lord through the Word, the Son of Man was seen in the midst of the candlesticks...

The seven candlesticks which thou sawest are the seven Churches () = the New Church on earth, which is the New Jerusalem descending from the Lord out of the New Heaven... By the seven candlesticks are not meant seven Churches, but the Church in the whole complex, which in itself is one, but is various according to reception...

Walking in the midst of the seven golden candlesticks () = from Whom comes all enlightenment to those who are of His Church. The seven candlesticks in the midst of which is the Son of Man = the Church which is in enlightenment from the Lord.
I will move thy candlestick out of its place if thou dost not repent () = that otherwise it is certain they will no longer be enlightened to see truths. Candlestick = the Church as to enlightenment.
The seven candlesticks = a New Church on earth which will be in enlightenment from the Lord.

They are the two olive-trees and the two candlesticks, which stand before the God of the earth () = love and intelligence, or charity and faith, both from the Lord with them... A candlestick = enlightenment in truths, and thence intelligence and faith.
On the table was placed a magnificent candelabrum fitted with seven branches and cups of gold...
Like a candelabrum with its lamps lighted.
Being turned, I saw seven golden candlesticks = a new Heaven and a new Church which are in the good of love. Ex and Illustrated. AE 89. AE 91. AE 96. AE 97.
To remove the candlestick out of its place = to separate from the Church and Heaven. AE 62:2.
The candlestick with its lamps = the Spiritual itself of that Kingdom. References.
The candlestick with its lamps represented and thence signified spiritual good and truth.

These are the two olive trees and the two candlesticks = the good of love to the Lord and of charity towards the neighbour, and the truth of doctrine and of faith, from which are Heaven and the Church... Candlestick, in a wide sense = the Lord's Spiritual Kingdom, and thence the spiritual Church, and as the principal thing of that Church is the truth of doctrine and the truth of faith, these are also signified by candlesticks.
By that luminary, or candlestick, was signified the Lord's spiritual Church, and by the fire kindled in the lamps was signified spiritual love, which is love towards the neighbour.
